purpose: Non-admission discovery registry for Verisk AIR CAT-model data, open exposure interchange, restricted events, output interoperability, and public benchmark evidence.

entries.name: CEDE 13.0 schema and AIRExposure, AIRReference and AIRReinsurance samples
entries.spatial_scope: Global interoperability format; sample coverage unverified
entries.resolution_or_granularity: SQL Server 2022 backup files and database reference
entries.note: CEDE is an open exposure schema, NOT an open AIR hazard/vulnerability model. Publisher offers sample .bak backups and separate CEDE License v1.0. Exact asset rights, sample bytes, retrieval, SHA256, and restore have not been checked. No admission or Neon import.

entries.name: CEDE 12.0 legacy schema and sample backups
entries.spatial_scope: Global interchange format; sample coverage unverified
entries.resolution_or_granularity: SQL Server 2022 .bak backups and legacy database reference
entries.note: Keep 12.0 and 13.0 identities separate; compare field and code differences explicitly. Public sample listing is not proof of data download or redistribution eligibility.

entries.name: AIREvents 2025 (13.1) catalogue table and climate-scenario documentation
entries.spatial_scope: Selected worldwide models, including Malaysia/Indonesia and Great Britain/Republic of Ireland
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Model 17 and 92 stochastic 10K event set tables and SSP scenario catalog descriptions
entries.note: Verisk documents Malaysia/Indonesia inland flood and GB/ROI inland flood SSP event sets, requested via Verisk representative; notes no geospatial/hazard analysis support for these climate event sets. Underlying event data are not publicly available for arbitrary use. Pin catalog vintage, model, scenario, time horizon.

entries.name: AIREvents and AIREventsHistorical catalogue access terms
entries.spatial_scope: Only perils and models covered by purchased licence
entries.temporal_scope: Documentation release 10.0; later terms must be verified separately
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 10K and 50K stochastic catalogues; separate historical and extreme scenario tables
entries.note: Official documentation says AIREvents are not included in standard software database install and are available on request for licensed models. Do not call event rows open data.

entries.name: Touchstone Re 13.0 exportable event, annual and treaty loss reports
entries.spatial_scope: Any model-covered licensed portfolio; no open portfolio implied
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Event Distribution nonzero event loss, Annual EP Detail nonzero annual loss, Summary EP, treaty and historical loss CSV reports
entries.note: Report selection is NOT a public event loss file. Preserve financial perspective, currency, event ID, simulation year, model/catalog version, zero-loss suppression, annual aggregation and secondary-uncertainty assumptions.

entries.name: Touchstone Re 13.0 ELT/YELT Analyze Re transfer
entries.spatial_scope: Licensed modelled output across supported model regions
entries.resolution_or_granularity: ELT default or YELT integration; Analyze Re upload supports 10K catalog only
entries.note: Verisk documents ELT/YELT export to Analyze Re; 50K/100K/500K and ALERT event sets excluded from this upload. No downloadable public ELT is established.

entries.name: Touchstone 13.0 encoded Company Loss File export
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Encoded CLF and EVT files with descriptive EVI summary; per peril/model/loss perspective
entries.note: CLF is not a plain CSV event loss table. Preserve model, catalog, currency, perspective and event ID; export requires authorized software and model data.

entries.name: Verisk ALERT recent event bulletins and subscriber scenario assets
entries.temporal_scope: Rolling historical and contemporary bulletins, checked 2026-11-02
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Public event narratives, industry estimates and mentions of subscriber hazard shapefiles/custom event sets
entries.note: German and Central European 2024 flood postings advertise event sets, loss-based similar stochastic events and shapefiles but explicitly restrict disclosure. No downloads of restricted vendor assets, no inclusion in Neon or Git; bulletin values are not observed ground-truth footprints.

entries.name: Verisk 2026 global modelled insured catastrophe loss benchmark
entries.spatial_scope: Global insurance industry risks within vendor model coverage
entries.temporal_scope: Provider release dated 2026-09-01; long-run modelled metrics, not realised annual loss
entries.resolution_or_granularity: AAL USD 171bn; aggregate 100-year EP USD 477bn; 250-year EP USD 606bn
entries.note: These are Verisk simulations for global insured industry, not company-specific losses, location-level exposure, stochastic events, or a prediction for 2026. AAL/EP cannot by themselves calibrate hazard/vulnerability. Preserve report date, global insured scope, currency and model vintage.
